charaepi_ch0356_80_zeiyu/2301_1101_0100_:
[Name:PlayerNickname ] spotted
Carmine and Hilbert having a dispute.
charaepi_ch0356_80_zeiyu/2301_1201_0200_:
What’s wrong, Mightyena? Did another
suspicious guy creep up?
charaepi_ch0356_80_zeiyu/2301_1201_0400_:
You weren’t startled by her barking,
were you?
charaepi_ch0356_80_zeiyu/2301_1201_0500_:
Mightyena was cautious around me too.
It was a bit troubling.
charaepi_ch0356_80_zeiyu/2301_1201_0600_: Well, Mightyena IS faithful to me.
charaepi_ch0356_80_zeiyu/2301_1201_0700_:
She was just suspicious of you two,
since you approached me casually.
charaepi_ch0356_80_zeiyu/2301_1201_0800_:
So she made herself intimidating to
protect me!
charaepi_ch0356_80_zeiyu/2301_1201_0900_:
She truly cares about her Trainer,
doesn’t she.
charaepi_ch0356_80_zeiyu/2301_1201_1000_:
But all I did was call out to her, since I also
have a partner Mightyena...
charaepi_ch0356_80_zeiyu/2301_1201_1100_:
You say that, but you REALLY came over
because you were so dazzled by me, right?
charaepi_ch0356_80_zeiyu/2301_1201_1300_:
What?! You’re supposed to be enamored and
distracted by my festival style!
charaepi_ch0356_80_zeiyu/2301_1201_1500_: I’m sure she agrees with me, her leader.
charaepi_ch0356_80_zeiyu/2301_1201_1600_:
Oh! Mightyena must trust you enough to see
you as pack leader!
charaepi_ch0356_80_zeiyu/2301_1201_1700_:
That just shows how skilled of a Trainer
you are.
charaepi_ch0356_80_zeiyu/2301_1201_1800_: Huh? So you DO know your stuff!
charaepi_ch0356_80_zeiyu/2301_1201_1900_:
You don’t look like you really understand,
[Name:PlayerNickname ]. Let me explain.
charaepi_ch0356_80_zeiyu/2301_1201_2100_:
They faithfully follow their leader’s orders
and show outstanding teamwork.
charaepi_ch0356_80_zeiyu/2301_1201_2200_:
But this one seems to recognize me as her
leader, even though I’m a Trainer.
charaepi_ch0356_80_zeiyu/2301_1201_2300_:
That’s why we have such good teamwork,
including in Pokémon battles!
charaepi_ch0356_80_zeiyu/2301_1201_2400_:
You said you have a partner Mightyena too.
How’s your relationship with yours?
charaepi_ch0356_80_zeiyu/2301_1201_2500_: I think what we’ve built is as good as yours!
charaepi_ch0356_80_zeiyu/2301_0301_2700_: Wanna team up and battle together?
charaepi_ch0356_80_zeiyu/2301_0401_2800_: You mean the three of us?
charaepi_ch0356_80_zeiyu/2301_0401_2900_: That’s not a bad idea, but...
charaepi_ch0356_80_zeiyu/2301_0402_3100_:
That sounds fun! I’d love to form a team
with you two!
charaepi_ch0356_80_zeiyu/2301_0402_3200_:
Well, some sort of fate brought us together,
so it’s not a bad idea, but...
charaepi_ch0356_80_zeiyu/2301_1201_3400_:
I’m never handing over my position as
leader! Got it? That’s the one thing I won’t
give up!
